body: CURRENT-STATE ADVERSARIAL RE-REVIEW — codex-storyatlas-root, exact StoryAtlas base 003f12b. The thesis and provider/consumer boundary still pass: one coordinated Codex/projection/inspector workspace; storymodel4s owns scientific meaning; StoryAtlas owns pagination, geometry, lowering, interaction, accessibility, and receipts; recall and interview remain packet-specific; Intaglio remains a backend rather than ontology; current WOG-only capability is mostly labelled honestly. Six amendments are now warranted by decisions made after these documents landed. V1. The vision says every interpretive mark must resolve to text evidence. Inferences may resolve through upstream claims, External or Unranked states may have recall rather than source evidence, and failure or UniverseState marks represent typed absence plus receipts. Require every mark to resolve to its evidence chain or explicit typed absence/outcome and provenance, not necessarily a direct source SpanSet. V2. Exact text remains the observational coordinate system for written stories and transcripts, but the accepted long-term film architecture has non-equivalent video, audio, timed-text, and presentation axes. Add a clearly future-labelled packet-specific observation paragraph; do not demote exact text for current text packets or claim film support now. M1. The mission omits the newly ruled story-output bundle: separate original and canonical text identities, canonical StoryModelCodec bytes, an always-present typed result, manifest roles, independent semantic/report/profile outcomes, local filesystem opening, and valid partial delivery when preview lowering fails. Add this before semantic-zoom expansion in the delivery sequence. M2. Every artifact has a deterministic textual twin is too broad for original byte payloads, binary assets, or a refused decoder. Every produced scientific visual report needs an accessible textual twin; nonvisual roles need their own exact-byte/schema/disposition laws. M3. Preserve placement across projection changes can be read as preserving geometry, which is false. Preserve semantic identity, requested-layer disposition, and SelectionPlacement truth while geometry changes under each declared ProjectionContract. M4. The no-story-specific-code mission is a target, not yet a demonstrated generality claim. Make the second substantial non-WOG narrative fixture an explicit admission gate before calling general rendering proven. Araby or another licensed source can fill it, but the law is fixture diversity rather than that title. None of these requires moving scientific logic into StoryAtlas. The documents remain strong and usable; this is a focused post-output and post-film amendment, not a rewrite or current-runtime claim. No file or tracker path was edited.
